content:
The **Helvetia Church** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

The church is located on the western end of town, opposite the Store and Post Office. It is inhabited by several Scorched as well as two corpses. Upon entering, there are three Voter Service Terminals on the western side and a Chemistry Station on the eastern side. Down the aisle is a depiction of a Mothman. A stairway leads up to the second floor in the northwestern corner.

The second floor has a Weapons Workbench on the northern side, while a set of stairs leads to the top of the spire on the southern side. The top of the spire has a Duffle Bag and a Chem Box.

The Helvetia Church appears in *Fallout 76*.
